identity_notes.model_id_note: model.id is SPARK_QWEN38_MAX_SERVING_DRIVER_MODEL_ID - the qwen38-common request contract passes it as driver_model_id and the serving-adapter template compares it against the driver descriptor at adapter_initialize (the vendor-style id string caused target_mismatch, the attach-r15j identity gap).
identity_notes.revision_note: model.revision is the contract source_revision (the HF snapshot sha the module and adapter embed via QWEN38_MODEL_REVISION); the serving-adapter template compares it against the driver contract at adapter_initialize - the previous h-string driver revision would have caused target_mismatch after the runtime-limits fix. The h-string fp8-h8192-l92-gdn69-full23-e512k10-v248320-mtp1-d2dc3565-v1 remains the module geometry documentation here: 92 layers (69 GDN / 23 full attention), hidden 8192, 512 experts top-10, vocab 248320, one MTP layer.
